The image shows a mango leaf with white powdery patches scattered across its surface. The leaf is curled/distorted, and the white spots appear to be a superficial powdery coating rather than black sooty deposits, sunken lesions, or gum secretions.

- The white powdery coating on the leaf surface matches Powdery Mildew symptoms (powdery infection on leaves causing leaf distortion and shedding).
- No black sooty encrustations (rules out Sooty Mould).
- No sunken brown/dark lesions (rules out Anthracnose).
- No gum secretion, bark darkening, or twig withering visible (rules out Die_Back).
